gripper.text: Pushed jaw finger CAD rev C to PDM. Root fillet is still the old 1.5 mm, I'm looking at it today.

Heads up on the finger stock: 7075 bar is eight weeks out from both distributors. 6061 is on the shelf, I can have it tomorrow.
FEA margin is fine either way. 6061 has less headroom but we're well above a 1.5 safety factor at 40 N.
the shop says 6061 machines nicer too, for what it's worth
ok, go with the 6061.
Lena, can I borrow the EVT unit this afternoon? Or are you still using it for the control loop?

Finger CAD needs one more day. With the switch to 6061 I want to rework the root fillet before it goes out, 1.5 mm is too tight now.
ok. tomorrow EOD?
tomorrow EOD, yes
Can we PLEASE agree on a file naming convention for CAD. I just found three files called finger_final_v2_REAL.sldprt
the convention is in the wiki. part number, rev, description
nobody follows the wiki. the PDM auto-names half of them anyway
electrical exports from KiCad don't even fit that scheme, we use board name + rev letter
then the wiki should have a section for electrical
my point is the wiki is not the convention if nobody uses it
my point is we have one and people should use it
underscores or dashes? the PDM chokes on dashes in some fields
it chokes on spaces, dashes are fine
dashes broke the STEP export script last year
that was fixed in November
was it? I still rename by hand
this is why we need one page that says exactly what to do
OK proposal: <part number>_<rev>_<short-desc>, all lowercase, no spaces
part numbers have uppercase letters in them though
fine, part number as-is, rest lowercase
and boards? mdb_revA_gerbers.zip style?
I'd rather not invent a second scheme
it's the same scheme, mdb is the short desc
I feel like we're going in circles
let's talk Friday.
Jaw finger CAD is done. Rev D with the bigger root fillet is released in PDM.
Is the FEA still on for today? I want to tell Acme we're on track
No, it has to be rerun for 6061, different yield and modulus. It'll land Thursday.

photos of the EVT sample fixture, the clamp jaws came out nice
